settings.tagline: Wood for houses, fences, roofs and furniture. Browse what is in the yard, ask for any size, and we will have it ready.
story: Peggy’s Timber Yard supplies timber to builders, fundis, farmers and homeowners. Every stack in the yard is sorted by kind and size, so you can walk in, point at what you need and leave with it.
Not sure what to use? Tell us what you are building and we will suggest the timber that fits the job and the budget.
